method.method_draft: First identify the atom connectivity from the image while ignoring all arrows. Treat the R group attached to the central carbon as a wildcard atom `*`. Start the SMILES from this wildcard bonded to the central carbon: `*C`. Add the oxygen anion and chlorine substituents as branches on that carbon: `*C([O-])(Cl)`. Then append the azide substituent attached through nitrogen, expanding `N3` as `N=[N+]=[N-]`. This yields `*C([O-])(Cl)N=[N+]=[N-]`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中中心原子是一个碳，左下连接 R 基，左上连接带负电标记的氧 O，右下连接 Cl，右上连接 N3；图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按照方法将 R 基视为通配符原子 *，并从该通配符连接中心碳开始写作 *C。中心碳上的氧负离子和氯作为支链，得到 *C([O-])(Cl)。右上方的 N3 是通过氮连接的叠氮基，展开为 N=[N+]=[N-]。因此完整 SMILES 为 *C([O-])(Cl)N=[N+]=[N-]。
